filters.label: Which filters should appear above the gallery?
filters.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the grid; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait. Empty (the default) = no filter bar, which is the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this gallery and routes `XFilter.FILTER -> REFETCH_FILTER` — that is the wired owner and remains the primary path. Use this knob only for a standalone gallery with no page-level filter affordance.
filters.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, dropdowns

imageField.label: Image field
imageField.description: Entity field holding the image URL shown in the lightbox for the selected item
imageField.synonyms: image url field, thumbnail field, src field

nameField.label: Name field
nameField.description: Entity field providing the lightbox alt text and caption for the selected item

filterBarLook.label: Filter bar look
filterBarLook.description: Visual treatment for the embedded filter bar, mirroring std-filter's own enum. Only applies when `filters` is non-empty.
filterBarLook.synonyms: filter bar style, facet style, chips, pills

bodySearch.label: Show the gallery's own search box?
bodySearch.description: Embeds a search box above the gallery grid. Set false (the default) when the page already provides a search affordance (a toolbar Search molecule), so the surface shows one search box instead of two.
bodySearch.synonyms: inline search, list search, built-in search, show search, duplicate search

pageSize.label: How many images to fetch per page?
pageSize.description: Records fetched from the server when REFETCH_PAGE fires (a composed std-pagination driving this trait). The initial load and revisit fetches stay unpaged (whole collection), unchanged from before this knob existed.
pageSize.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, batch size, page limit

searchPlaceholder.label: Search box placeholder text
searchPlaceholder.description: Hint text inside the gallery search box (e.g. 'Search photos…').
searchPlaceholder.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text, search label

title.label: Section title
title.description: Heading shown above the image gallery
